name: fam-10-write
prompt: Session ids arrive raw from query strings. Add ValidSessionID(id string) bool to session.go (2..64 chars, ASCII letters/digits/hyphens only) and enforce it in Store.Get (return a new ErrInvalidID) and in main.go's POST/GET branches (400). Document the rule in a comment on ValidSessionID.
check:
grep -F -q 'func ValidSessionID' session.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
